## Case studies

- [AI Job Hunt engine](https://solomonjoshua.com/work/ai-job-hunt/): an AI system that checks job fit, catches scams and drafts honest applications, with Josh's approval. Live since 20 Oct 2026 on Cloudflare Workers: every day from 7 AM Manila time, Claude Opus 5.5 vets new roles from 5 public job-board APIs (fit 1–10, scam risk, pay). Job posts are untrusted input (prompt-injection checks), an adversarial second pass removes any claim not in the CV, send rules are enforced by a database CHECK constraint, and a hard daily budget caps AI spend (about $1–2.50 a day, estimated). Anything unclear waits for approval; a Google Apps Script Gmail bridge sends from Gmail. 700+ automated tests.
- Agency email & SMS platform (Arrow Group Consulting, 2026): built with Claude Code on Cloudflare Workers + D1; 6 client accounts live on it about 5 weeks after the first commit; 3,200+ automated tests; projected ~89% lower monthly platform cost (a projection from the business case); now replacing GoHighLevel.
